task: No-go on kennel-book: Buyers search "dog boarding software" (390 a month US) and "kennel software" (140), about 870 a month of buyer terms in all, and page one is held by Kennel Connection, ProPet, KennelBooker, DoggieDashboard and Capterra (https://www.capterra.com/kennel-software/); the high volume boarding searches are pet owners on Rover, Wag and Yelp. The small end is already served: DoggieDashboard is free up to 10 pets and USD 40 a month after (https://doggiedashboard.com/), and Capterra lists a free tier for PetPocketbook. The case scored 18 of 35 with distribution 2, so search only distribution cannot reach paying kennels in 90 days (cases/kennel-book.md).
